restoreFails.title: A restore stops part-way once

pairExpires.title: A pairing request expires
pairExpires.sub: On Pairing, the approval request runs out after a few seconds; Send it again works.

nameTaken.title: GitHub name taken
nameTaken.sub: The online copy's name is already used at creation.

flaky.title: Flaky network
flaky.sub: Making the online copy fails once on the network.

cliMissing.title: Claude not installed
cliMissing.sub: Claude has to be installed before signing in.

signedOut.title: Claude signed out
signedOut.sub: Claude is installed but nobody is signed in.

copiedUnavailable.title: Copied account unavailable
copiedUnavailable.sub: An account copied from another computer cannot be used here.

remoteAi.title: AI on a remote Server
remoteAi.sub: The AI accounts live on the Server, not here.

noAi.title: No AI account anywhere
noAi.sub: Nothing signed in on this computer or the Server.

claudeExpired.title: Claude sign-in expired
claudeExpired.sub: Claude was signed in here before; that sign-in has expired, so it asks to sign in again.

aiOffline.title: Offline once during AI setup
aiOffline.sub: The first sign-in or key check finds no connection and says so; the next try works.

antigravityOnce.title: Antigravity sign-in fails once
antigravityOnce.sub: The first browser sign-in does not finish; Pip looks worried, the second try works.

githubSigninOnce.title: GitHub sign-in fails once
githubSigninOnce.sub: The online copy's sign-in does not finish the first time; the second try works.

sshNotAllowed.title: Home NAS doesn't let this account use SSH
sshNotAllowed.sub: Adding the key is refused for this account; Synology's own rule is named, and a shared folder is offered instead.

githubHalfMade.title: GitHub copy made, setup stops once
githubHalfMade.sub: Creating stops after GitHub made the copy; Continue Setup finishes it, or deleting the online copy removes only that copy.

githubUnclear.title: GitHub's answer is unclear once
githubUnclear.sub: Creating can't tell whether the copy was made; nothing is retried on its own; Check again reads the next answer.

kitTestFails.title: The Recovery Kit test fails once
kitTestFails.sub: On Finish protecting your work, Test the kit says it didn't open the backup; the second test works.

protectRefused.title: Saving the Recovery Kit is turned down once
protectRefused.sub: On Finish protecting your work, saving the kit doesn't finish and nothing is saved; Try again works.

serverOldAnswer.title: The Server answers an approval for an old code once
serverOldAnswer.sub: Approving a device (this computer on Set up, or another one on Your Server is ready) is answered for an old code; Approve again works.

serverWrongDevice.title: The Server answers for another device once
serverWrongDevice.sub: The Server's first answer (setting it up, or an approval) names another device; Check again or Approve again works.

serverNoWords.title: A device's request comes without its words once
serverNoWords.sub: On Your Server is ready, the next device's request has no words to compare; New code asks it again.

story.lead: Behind the app runs a pretend project with its own clock. Play it, speed it up, or jump ahead.

story.overSub: Reloads the page. Your layout and settings stay.

workspace.title: The Home workspace
workspace.lead: Change the panel layout and watch agents work beside you.
workspace.layoutsLead: Open tabs move into the new shape; nothing closes.
workspace.resetLayoutSub: Panels go back to their default places. Open files, terminals and chats stay.
workspace.agentsSub: Six agents open a terminal, a browser, a plan, a file, a Crew run and another agent’s chat, each behind your work.
workspace.terminalSub: Query Analyzer opens its own terminal in the background and reruns the bench.
workspace.askSub: An agent asks to type into your terminal. You allow it once, for the terminal, or say no.

titlebar.title: Title bar
titlebar.lead: The project box, Pip's mark and the bar's own folds (option A, Tab). Every state is read off the work projection the box reads; nothing here is saved.
titlebar.unavailable: The project box is not on this page.

calm.title: Calm
calm.sub: Nothing running: the box shows no mark.

working.title: Working
working.sub: An agent runs in the background.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.sub: An agent cannot go on. Its own mark, apart from needs you.

needs.title: Needs you
needs.sub: An agent asks a question. It wins over every other state.

unsaved.title: Unsaved
unsaved.sub: Opens a file in Home: type in it and the box shows Unsaved.

box.icon: the box folded to its folder

titlebar.longSub: Adds the Project {name} and switches to it, as onboarding does for a new one, in the look on screen; the name ends in an ellipsis. Off goes back.
titlebar.menuSub: Projects, with each one's state in words beside its mark.
titlebar.unsavedToast: A file is open in Home. Type in it: the box shows Unsaved.

blocked.detail: Production schema changes need your explicit override.

activity.unavailableLead: The work projection's scenarios are not on this page.
activity.scenesLead: Each is a world of its own; picking one replaces what runs now.

busy.title: Busy
busy.sub: 22 agents and 10 processes; three things wait on you.

no-asks.title: No asks
no-asks.sub: The same work with nothing waiting on you.

quiet.title: Quiet
quiet.sub: Nothing running: the chat's Processes icon goes away.

many.title: Many
many.sub: 34 more processes across four agents, for long lists and By owner.

stale.title: Stale feed
stale.sub: Busy, last heard from 40 seconds ago; the counts stay as they were.

restart.title: After restart
restart.sub: Two processes ended while Puppet Master was closed: Lost.

servers.title: Several servers
servers.sub: Busy across four servers and six environments, for the Resources tab.

activity.panelSub: Rises from the status bar at one tab.
activity.chatProcessesSub: Activity Detail at Processes, on a thread with a process running or waiting on input (the current one when it has one).
activity.stopAllSub: Everything running across Puppet Master, listed so any of it can be unticked first.
activity.quitSub: Quitting with work running asks: keep it running on the server, or stop what is ticked.

activity.chatProcessesNone: No thread in the chat has a process running or waiting, so there is no Processes view: load Busy first.
activity.chatProcessesRefused: The chat did not open its Processes view for that thread.

chat.title: The assistant chat
chat.lead: Play a recorded example, put the chat in a moment, or try another design. It all runs in the chat on the right; nothing real is touched.
chat.showSub: Bring the chat on screen on the Home page.
chat.resetSub: Every chat, answer, artifact and working state goes back to the start.
chat.resetDone: The chat demo is back to its start.
chat.unavailableLead: The assistant chat is not on this page, so its examples cannot run here.
chat.nowHidden: Hidden. Show the chat brings it back; every example shows it too.

guided.lead: Each example plays on its own once it starts: the chat presses its own buttons, lit first, and says what comes next. The Studio steps aside while it plays.

plan.title: Plan
plan.lead: A plan is written, approved and built; stopped and revised; recovered after a failed step.

goal.title: Goal
goal.lead: A goal runs to a real, checked result, and you stay the owner of what it is for.

todo.title: To-Dos
todo.lead: Work splits into items that run side by side, and the progress shown is honest.

deepplan.title: Deep Plan
deepplan.lead: A deeper plan asks only what it must, inside one question allowance everyone shares.

schedule.title: Scheduling
schedule.lead: Messages and builds that run later, exactly as you scheduled them.

crew.title: Crew
crew.lead: A team of assistants splits a job, and each part is checked.

room.title: Chat Room
room.lead: Several assistants talk a question through, with a moderator.

brainstorm.title: BrainStorm
brainstorm.lead: Ideas drafted alone, debated, then written up as one plan.

review.title: Review
review.lead: Fresh reviewers read a locked copy of the work and report.

wonderer.title: Wonderer and Grill Me
wonderer.lead: Grill Me asks you first; the Wonderer brings leads the team weighs.

lens.title: Context Lens
lens.lead: Choose what the assistant reads, preview it, and restore it unchanged.

teach.title: Teach
teach.lead: Save a rule from a message, then see replies follow it.

memory.title: Memory
memory.lead: Notes the assistant keeps, checked against your files.

eli5.title: ELI5
eli5.lead: Simple explanations, one chat at a time.

thinking.title: Thought Stream
thinking.lead: The reasoning a model shares streams in while it thinks. Your setting folds it away or keeps it open.

bsd.title: Back Seat Driver
bsd.lead: A second model watches the work and speaks up only when it matters.

debug.title: Debug
debug.lead: Reproduce a bug, fix it, and prove the fix.

revert.title: Revert
revert.lead: Undo the assistant’s last change, never yours.

attach.title: Attachments
attach.lead: Files and folders the assistant reads, kept exactly as you attached them.

more.title: More examples
more.lead: Examples the chat has that this Studio has no words for yet, in the chat’s own words.

pip.title: Pip
pip.lead: The chat's assistants drawn as Pip, from waiting to done.

plan-complete.title: Build a small plan
plan-complete.sub: Approve the plan, watch its To-Dos run, see it finish.

plan-revise.title: Stop and revise
plan-revise.sub: Stop a plan, give feedback and get version 2. Version 1 stays as it was.

plan-recovery.title: Recover without starting over
plan-recovery.sub: A lookup fails, you repair its input, and the same plan run tries again.

plan-documents.title: Read the exact evidence
plan-documents.sub: Open the plan’s evidence, publish a newer source, and the approved version stays unchanged.

goal-simple.title: A goal that makes a real file
goal-simple.sub: Send a goal, pause it, then finish a CSV that is checked on its own.

goal-authority.title: You own the goal
goal-authority.sub: Edit the goal yourself, then approve or refuse a change the assistant asks for.

goal-plan.title: Build a plan as a goal
goal-plan.sub: Write a regular plan, then choose how it runs.

goal-scheduled.title: A scheduled build is not a goal yet
goal-scheduled.sub: Schedule a plan. It becomes a goal only when its time comes.

todo-parallel.title: Parallel work, honest progress
todo-parallel.sub: Two files are made side by side, then checked separately.

todo-restructure.title: Change the list without losing work
todo-restructure.sub: Pause, move one item that is running, then carry on from where it was.

todo-large.title: A list of 5,000 items
todo-large.sub: Search, fold and open one item in a list of 5,050.

deepplan-thorough.title: A few questions, a complete plan
deepplan-thorough.sub: Reuse an answer, look through what was found, and stop well before the limit.

deepplan-exhaustive.title: Research can go out of date
deepplan-exhaustive.sub: A source changes. Check it before you accept the deeper plan.

deepplan-budget.title: One question allowance for everyone
deepplan-budget.sub: Reach the limit, then add Grill Me without resetting the count.

deepplan-blocker.title: An open question can hold the build
deepplan-blocker.sub: A safety question stays open and visible instead of being guessed.

schedule-due.title: Schedule and build
schedule-due.sub: Schedule version 1, see when it is due, and watch it finish.

schedule-revise.title: Revise a scheduled plan
schedule-revise.sub: Schedule version 1, revise it, then choose version 2 on purpose.

schedule-cancel.title: Cancel a scheduled build
schedule-cancel.sub: Schedule it, cancel it, and see that nothing runs.

schedule-messages.title: Send the version you scheduled
schedule-messages.sub: The message and its attachment are kept as scheduled. A missing one holds the send.

schedule-windows.title: One build across two windows
schedule-windows.sub: The build pauses at a safe point when its window ends and resumes the same run.

schedule-crew.title: Schedule a Crew
schedule-crew.sub: Set the Crew up once. It starts as one and resumes the same work.

schedule-room.title: Send to the same discussion
schedule-room.sub: One scheduled message reaches the discussion you chose, and only that one.

schedule-folder.title: Keep a folder unchanged
schedule-folder.sub: Every selected file is kept. A missing one holds the whole message.

crew-delegation.title: Delegate and check
crew-delegation.sub: A Crew splits a job into parts and checks each one.

crew-auto.title: Crew Auto knows when to help
crew-auto.sub: Small requests stay with one assistant; a big job gets a Crew.

room-discussion.title: Talk it through, keep one idea
room-discussion.sub: Two rounds with the moderator. You join in, then turn one message into a To-Do.

room-plan.title: Turn the conclusion into a plan
room-plan.sub: Everyone answers once, the moderator sums up, and the summary becomes a plan.

brainstorm-synthesis.title: Decide and write one plan
brainstorm-synthesis.sub: Ideas drafted alone, a debate, then one plan.

brainstorm-constraint.title: A rule beats the vote
brainstorm-constraint.sub: The popular option breaks a rule. Its backers’ view is kept, and the plan follows the rule.

review-single.title: One reviewer
review-single.sub: A fresh reviewer reads a locked copy and writes a report.

review-multi.title: Several reviewers
review-multi.sub: Three reviewers check alone, compare notes, and you pick the To-Dos.

wonderer-crew.title: A Crew that grills you first
wonderer-crew.sub: Grill Me before the work splits. The Wonderer’s leads are decided as they arrive.

wonderer-room.title: A Chat Room with both
wonderer-room.sub: The moderator grills you, the leads join between turns, and every lead reaches the summary.

wonderer-brainstorm.title: A BrainStorm weighs the leads
wonderer-brainstorm.sub: Grill Me at the start. Write the plan waits for every pass, decision and lookup.

wonderer-deepplan.title: Deep Plan with Grill Me
wonderer-deepplan.sub: Questions round by round, a pause to look a fact up, then one agreed plan.

wonderer-leads.title: The team weighs the leads
wonderer-leads.sub: Leads wait until every proposal is in, then the debate decides them.

wonderer-dissent.title: A rule beats the vote, without the Wonderer
wonderer-dissent.sub: One lead is explored and not supported. The rule wins, and every lead is in the plan.

lens-shape.title: Shape, summarise and restore
lens-shape.sub: Mute, focus, preview a source, then restore the history unchanged.

lens-stale.title: A preview is not a promise
lens-stale.sub: A source changes, the old Apply is refused, and you review the new version.

teach-capture.title: Save a rule from a message
teach-capture.sub: Save the assistant’s advice as a rule, then see a reply follow it.

teach-correct.title: Edit a rule, then turn it off
teach-correct.sub: Teach a rule, save version 2, turn it off. The old version never comes back.

teach-missed.title: When a reply misses your rule
teach-missed.sub: A reply leaves part of a rule out and you ask for a fix. Nothing is sent until you press Send.

memory-verified.title: A note a test proves
memory-verified.sub: Three checks pass. Then the file changes and the note goes out of date.

memory-locked.title: Your rule stays yours
memory-locked.sub: A note suggests changing a locked rule. Nothing changes until you decide.

eli5-override.title: Simple answers in one chat
eli5-override.sub: Turn ELI5 on for one chat and compare it with one that stays standard.

eli5-inherit.title: Back to your usual setting
eli5-inherit.sub: Undo one chat’s own choice so it follows its project again.

thinking-auto.title: While it thinks
thinking-auto.sub: The reasoning streams in, then folds to one line when the answer starts. Open the line to read it again.

thinking-expanded.title: Always open
thinking-expanded.sub: The same question, with the reasoning kept open above the answer.

bsd-survives.title: Catch a missing measurement
bsd-survives.sub: The advisor spots a missing measurement, checks it on newer work, then tells you.

bsd-resolves.title: Settled before it reaches you
bsd-resolves.sub: The advisor spots a problem, a measurement settles it, and nothing appears in your chat.

debug-repair.title: Reproduce, fix and close
debug-repair.sub: Find a zero-quantity bug, check six cases, and remove the helper the fix used.

debug-drift.title: The file changed under you
debug-drift.sub: Another edit is caught before the fix. You choose to carry on without losing either history.

revert-whole.title: Revert one whole change
revert-whole.sub: The assistant edits, adds and deletes a file. Revert puts all three back.

revert-conflict.title: Your later edit is protected
revert-conflict.sub: You change a file after the assistant did. Revert refuses and leaves every file as it is.

attach-intake.title: Attach, retry and remove
attach-intake.sub: Attach files, retry one that failed, remove one. The others and your text stay.

attach-live.title: Files that changed since
attach-live.sub: Each turn keeps what it read. A later change is shown without rewriting history.

attach-folder.title: Folders stay bounded
attach-folder.sub: A folder is read as a fixed list of files, with its own receipt.

pip-delegation.title: A Crew of Pips
pip-delegation.sub: A Crew run from queued to done, every member drawn as Pip with its role's prop.

pip.title: Pip in the chat

live.title: Live turns

lifecycle.lead: Start, pause, step and finish the working card, with helpers and a Crew.

working.title: Every working state
working.lead: The working card at each of its steps.

decisions.title: Questions and decisions

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.lead: Diagrams, dashboards, charts and documents, opened in the panels.

capabilities.title: Assistant abilities
capabilities.lead: Back Seat Driver, Context Lens, ELI5 and goals.

threads.title: Chats and messages
threads.lead: Plain chats, queued messages, archives, search and drafts.

system.title: Tools and connections
system.lead: Web, browser and test tools, going offline, attachments and accounts.

scheduling.title: Scheduling screens
scheduling.lead: Where scheduled messages and build windows are set up.

safety.title: Safety checks
safety.lead: What the chat refuses to do twice, or on its own.

lineups.title: Lineups and advisors
lineups.lead: Who takes part, and how the advisor works.

views.title: Plans, records and previews
views.lead: Plan tabs, the record behind a change, previews and small surfaces.

more-surfaces.title: More moments
more-surfaces.lead: Moments the chat has that this Studio has no words for yet, in the chat’s own words.

walls.refused: The wallpaper didn't change: Settings couldn't save it on this page.

pip.title: Pip, Puppet Master's mark
pip.lead: Pip in every look, its faces on every live Pip, the loader and the sound board. The drawings are the kit's own; nothing here is saved.
pip.unavailable: Pip's kit is not on this page.

looks.title: Pip in every look
looks.lead: The title bar's still 24 px mark, the look's tile and the tray's faces at 16 px, each on its look's own ground. The app icon is the Basic Dark tile in every look.
looks.trayOrder: Tray faces, left to right, in the order the tray picks one: {list}.

trayBar.title: The tray and menu bar
trayBar.lead: Each face as the system shows it at 16 px: macOS template images in one ink on a light and a dark menu bar, and the colour mark in the Windows taskbar.
trayBar.note: Working is a four-frame flip a tray plays by swapping images; here it plays as the kit draws it. The colour mark is the app icon's Basic Dark Pip.

moods.title: Faces
moods.lead: Pick a face: every live Pip on screen wears it for a moment, then goes back to its own.
moods.none: No live Pip is on screen. Open onboarding, or a sheet in the chat (Chat, Moments), then pick a face.
moods.noneToast: No live Pip is on screen right now.

squeeze.title: A squeezed title bar
squeeze.sub: Narrows the bar step by step until its own density shows Pip's mark without the wordmark. Each step runs the bar's real layout pass, so the page pauses about half a second between steps.
squeeze.subMark: The bar shows Pip's mark only now, at {n} px.
squeeze.done: The brand folds to Pip's mark at {n} px.

loader.title: The loader
loader.lead: One loader for every wait, drawn by the loader's owner at each size. The motion here is a take: the app picks it by what is waiting.
loader.unavailable: The loader is not on this page.
loader.context: Think waits on a reply, Hop on a short wait that ends well, Swing on every other wait.
loader.nier: NieR keeps its own loader: Pip never moves in NieR.
loader.reduced: With Reduce motion on, the control breathes and Pip blinks; nothing travels.
loader.everySub: All three motions at every size, the chat's thinking line on a live turn, and a busy button, at once. A panel waiting is the row below.
loader.busySub: This button wears the loader for a short wait.
loader.holdSub: Waits that end on their button (Refresh Projects, the busy button, Settings' checks) keep their loader up, so it can be looked at; off ends them. Waits drawn from their state, like the chat's Building…, end with their state.
loader.panelSub: Projects › Refresh: the loader takes the button's icon place while the list is rescanned. With Hold loaders on it stays.
loader.splashSub: Not on this page: PMConcept7 paints straight into Home, with no splash screen to hold.

sound.title: Pip's sound board
sound.lead: Pip's kits, loops and voice through the one player, under Sound effects. The kit follows the look, or try another.
sound.unavailable: Pip's sound is not on this page.
sound.offSub: Pip is quiet while Sound effects is off. Turn it on to hear the board.

bed.title: Bed
bed.sub: The setup music's bed, with the Setup music part on.

sound.sayDefault: Hi! I'm Pip. Let's set up your first Project.
sound.offToast: Sound effects is off. Turn it on to hear Pip.
sound.quiet: Pip keeps that one quiet here.
sound.voiceOff: Pip's setup voice part is off.

reset.title: Start the demo over
reset.lead: Choose how much goes. Nothing outside this concept is touched.

progress.title: Progress
progress.sub: Onboarding, the Guided Tour and the situation go back to a fresh computer. Then onboarding opens.

layout.title: Workspace layout
layout.sub: The Home panels go back to their default layout. Nothing else changes.

everything.title: Everything
everything.sub: All of the above and everything else this concept saved in this browser, the 5.6 Pro chat demo's data included. Then the page reloads as a first run.

reset.staysLayout: Open tabs, onboarding, the tour and settings.
reset.staysEverything: Nothing kept by this concept. Your real files and accounts were never touched.

items.tour: Guided Tour progress and its saved layout
items.chat56: The assistant chat demo's data (5.6 Pro)
items.studio: Where this Studio was moved to

switches.title: Reload with switches
switches.lead: Review switches live in the page address. Pick them, then reload. They last for that visit.
switches.normalSub: Onboarding opens on a first run.
switches.offSub: Straight to the app (what automated checks use).
switches.freshSub: Onboarding from the start, in Basic Dark.
switches.tourOnSub: The tour begins as the page opens.
switches.pmhSub: Cards and rows without the shared hover.
switches.liveSub: The Usage page opens without new readings.
switches.softSub: Usage draws the way a computer without graphics acceleration sees it.
switches.copyFailed: This page can't copy, so the address is selected in its field: copy it from there.

toast.resetLayout: The Home layout is back to its default.
toast.unavailable: That is not available on this page right now.

studio.moveHint: Drag the title bar, or press the arrow keys here (Shift for bigger steps). Home puts it back in its corner.
studio.putBack: Put the Studio back in its corner
